description: This file defines a command handler class 'ApplyAddtionalSharesCommandHandler' for processing commands related to applying additional shares in a share account system. It uses Spring annotations for service and transaction management, and integrates with a service layer to perform the actual business logic.

classes.name: ApplyAddtionalSharesCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to apply additional shares to a share account, delegating business logic to ShareAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: ApplyAddtionalSharesCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ShareAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command by invoking the share account service to apply additional shares.
